points.title: Build system and reproducibility

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:106–121 reads current restart state, step and time but only passes the state into solver; transient history and resume time are not restored.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh, partition, finite-volume solver, gas model, I/O and utilities; numerical result evidence is unavailable.

points.title: Originality and license compliance

points.title: No hard-coded case logic

points.title: MPI correctness

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable clean build passes with warnings; CLI loads current restart state but does not resume time or BDF history, and case outputs are absent.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS/METIS owned/ghost mesh paths exist; all nonroot ranks drop preprocessing full mesh before solving.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Source implements conservative Rusanov residual and boundary/viscous paths; no surviving case outputs support numerical validation.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Gradient and limiter source enables second order after startup blend; actual run mode and order cannot be checked without logs or cases.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Stress and heat paths exist; Solver.cpp:676–704 includes full traction in total force but only tangential traction in reported viscous split, so the split can fail to sum.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Implicit/BDF2 code counts strict misses separately, but no original outcome survives; restart restores current state only, without time/previous BDF level.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS and neighbor halos/reductions exist; root-only global mesh remains during solving, workers drop it. Reported rank results cannot be checked.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: All eight case packages are absent in current workspace. Report numeric claims alone do not establish result completion.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Tracked TeX describes methods and claimed values, but no rendered figures, PDF or original output/manifests survive and curated report cannot compile.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separated gas, mesh, solver and I/O interfaces support some extension even though numerical results are absent; code remains specialized 2-D ideal gas.
